title: Square Integrability of a Biased Bit
statement: For every real number $p$ with $0\le p\le 1$, the function on a Boolean bit that takes value $1$ on true and $0$ on false belongs to $L^2$ with respect to the probability measure assigning mass $p$ to true and $1-p$ to false.
